name: Float, sauna, cryotherapy and wellness studio

pf.license.need: no state license for float, sauna or cryotherapy in most places; a local health permit where the local rules treat float tanks, plunge pools or saunas as pools or spas (the business's own permit, shown as its word; none is checked by Rosie, D96)
pf.license.who: the business, for its registration and any local health permit it chooses to show
pf.license.ask: optional: the business registration and any local permit it wants shown; nothing is asked of each attendant
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never checks a permit, license or insurance for this work (D96)
pf.license.certificates: the cryotherapy maker's operator training and CPR certificates are the business's own word, shown that way, never as a license
pf.license.blocks: nothing: no permit or certificate blocks a booking here
pf.license.claims: no health or medical claims for any service; what the studio says about a service is its own word, never Rosie's
pf.license.insurance: general liability insurance is optional: the business's own word; host places and events may ask to see it, and the business shows it there
pf.license.renewals: none checked; a renewal date a permit or certificate carries is only a reminder the business sets itself

pf.services.shape: private rooms booked by time like a space (float rooms, sauna suites, the cryotherapy chamber, the contrast suite, the red light bed, the compression chairs), with a trained staff member on duty; no person is named; flow B: a mobile sauna and cold plunge delivered to a home or event and run by a staff member, and wellness days at a host's place where guests book seats
pf.services.examples: the example studio's own prices, not a standard

list.name: Float, 60 minutes
list.length: 60 minutes in the room, plus 30 minutes to clean and filter the room after
list.note: a shower before and after; ages 16 and up, 16 and 17 with a parent's signed OK

list.name: Infrared sauna suite
list.note: ages 12 and up with a parent in the suite

list.name: Whole-body cryotherapy
list.length: 3 minutes in the chamber, about 15 minutes with check-in
list.needs: a trained operator in the room the whole time
list.note: ages 18 and up (16 and 17 with a parent's signed OK, where the studio allows it); blood pressure checked before every session

list.name: Contrast suite (sauna and cold plunge)
list.before: a card saved for the $25 late-cancel fee

list.name: Compression session
list.where: one of 4 chairs in the lounge

list.name: Membership
list.price: $129 a month: 4 sessions of any kind
list.after: charged monthly, with its own yes to the terms
list.note: one month's unused sessions roll over once; 30 days' notice to cancel

pf.services.capacity: 3 float rooms, 2 sauna suites, 1 cryotherapy chamber, 1 contrast suite, 4 compression chairs, 1 red light bed; each room's reset time is kept free after a booking

beforeTimes: new to the studio, or been before (sets the first-float price and the briefing)
one person or two (suites for two)
for flow B: a home, an event or an office, the town, and how many guests
afterTime: anything staff should know (first time, nervous in small spaces)
securePage: the waiver, signed by each person (a parent signs for anyone under 18)

the health questions for each service, the studio's own list: pregnancy; a heart condition, high blood pressure or a pacemaker; seizures; open wounds or a skin infection; a tattoo or hair dye in the last 2 weeks (float); cold allergy, poor circulation in the hands or feet (cryotherapy); alcohol or drugs today
a doctor's written OK where an answer needs one under the studio's rule
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs; each guest at a mobile sauna or a wellness day fills their own forms

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, a seizure, someone not answering in a float room or sauna

goOn.words: pregnant, a heart condition, high blood pressure, a pacemaker, seizures
goOn.what: the health questions decide which services may be booked, by the studio's own list; some need a doctor's written OK; Rosie gives no medical advice

goOn.words: a burn, a cold burn or a rash after a session
goOn.what: the studio's own line; staff give first aid; 911 if it's serious

pf.safety.sobriety: nobody who has had alcohol or drugs that day uses the float, sauna, plunge or cryotherapy
pf.safety.cryo: a trained operator stays in the room for the whole session; never over 3 minutes; never with wet skin or clothes; blood pressure checked first
pf.safety.float: staff check on a floater by the room's intercom if they don't come out on time
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and health questions
steps.when: on the secure page while booking, before the first visit, again each year and whenever health changes
steps.who: every person who uses a service; a parent signs for anyone under 18; each guest at a mobile sauna or wellness day signs their own
steps.result: all clear: it books; an answer the studio's list rules out: another service or no booking, before any money; an answer that needs a doctor's OK: it books only once the OK is on file

steps.name: Doctor's written OK
steps.when: before the session, where the studio's rule asks for one (pregnancy for a float, a heart condition for the sauna)
steps.who: the customer brings or uploads it
steps.result: on file: it goes ahead; not in: another service, or a move with no fee

steps.name: Blood pressure check
steps.when: at the front desk right before each cryotherapy session
steps.result: under the studio's limit: the session goes ahead; over: no cryotherapy today, another service or a refund

steps.name: First-visit briefing
steps.when: at the start of a first float or cryotherapy session, 5 minutes
steps.result: staff show how the room or chamber works

pf.first_steps.prep: no alcohol that day; eat lightly 1 hour before; for a float, no shaving that day and no new tattoo or hair dye in the last 2 weeks; for cryotherapy, dry skin and no lotion

pf.visit.checkIn: at the front desk: the check-in code; for cryotherapy, the blood pressure check first; at a mobile sauna or a wellness day (flow B): each guest's own code on the host's list
pf.visit.beforeWork: staff check the health questions are done for each person, show first-timers the room, and for cryotherapy check dry skin, gloves, socks and slippers
pf.visit.changes: a session ended early for safety is done another way or refunded for the part not given; an added session is priced first and needs a free room
pf.visit.done: the check-in code; for flow B, DONE from the staff member after pack-up
pf.visit.after: staff check each room is reset before the next booking

pf.money.before: most sessions are paid in full when booking; the contrast suite, compression and red light save a card for the fee and are paid at the front desk; packs and memberships are paid ahead; a mobile sauna takes a $200 deposit with the rest 3 days before; a wellness day takes a 25% deposit from the host
pf.money.after: the front desk for card-saved services; the host's bill for a wellness day
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 12 hours before (the owner's setting); 7 days for a mobile sauna; a cancel for a health reason found by the questions is always free
pf.money.fees: $25 for a late cancel or no-show (example), or the session is used from a pack or membership, only with the owner's OK A customer turned away for having had alcohol or drugs that day is treated like a late cancel: the fee, or the used session, is the owner's call. A health answer or a blood pressure reading that stops a session is never charged.
pf.money.membership: charged monthly to the saved card after the membership's own yes; unused sessions roll over 1 month; cancel with 30 days' notice (the example's terms) or as the state's rules require
pf.money.refunds: a session the studio cancels (a room out of order) is refunded or moved; no refund after the session starts, except a stop for safety
pf.money.giftCards: gift cards are the studio's own, set on the portal
pf.money.tax: where the state's rules tax these services
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 applies: one $2 per confirmed booking; a membership counts once a month

pf.messages.never: health answers, blood pressure readings, a doctor's OK and a child's details never go in a text: only the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: texts to staff name the customer, the room and the time only; they never say which answer needs a check
pf.messages.minors: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.skills: front desk, float rooms, cryotherapy operator (trained by the maker), sauna and plunge, mobile sauna driver and setup
pf.staff.supervision: a trained cryotherapy operator in the room for every session; at least one CPR-trained staff member on duty whenever rooms are booked
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs fees, refunds and mobile bookings, and decides which health answers need a doctor's OK
pf.staff.standIn: no person is named; any trained staff member on duty runs a session
pf.staff.away: only staff cleared to tow and set up the trailer run mobile bookings

pf.rules.health: local health rules for float tanks, plunge pools and saunas (water testing, cleaning between users) where the local rules treat them as pools or spas (switches)
pf.rules.claims: no medical claims in listings or texts
pf.rules.minors: minimum ages by service, the studio's own rule and the state's where it has one
pf.rules.records: waivers and health questions kept 7 years, longer for minors where the state asks

pf.edges.healthNo: an answer that rules out the service: another service or no booking, told on the page, never in a text
pf.edges.bloodPressure: blood pressure over the limit at the desk: no cryotherapy today; another service or a refund
pf.edges.roomOut: a float room or the chamber out of order: another room, another service or a move with no fee
pf.edges.late: a late customer: the session is shorter, so the room's reset and the next booking stay on time
pf.edges.faint: someone faints or feels unwell: first aid, 911 if serious; the owner told at once
pf.edges.weather: a mobile sauna in lightning or high wind: use stops; the rest moves or is refunded
pf.edges.couple: two people in a suite: each signs their own waiver and health questions
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
